Nightlife Transportation Old Town Scottsdale: Party Without Parking

Old Town Scottsdale is Arizona's premier nightlife destination, but parking? That's where the party stops. Here's how smart party-goers navigate the scene.

The Old Town Parking Problem

  • Limited street parking after 6 PM
  • Garage rates: $10-30 per evening
  • Walking distances of 0.5+ miles
  • Car prowls common in remote lots
  • No parking near hottest venues

Why Use Nightlife Transportation?

  • VIP arrival at every venue
  • No parking tickets or tow risks
  • Everyone drinks safely
  • No surge pricing unlike rideshare at 2 AM
  • Group stays together all night

Old Town Hot Spots

Entertainment District (Main)

  • Bottled Blonde - Upscale party
  • The Mint - Hip-hop heavy
  • Maya Day + Nightclub - EDM energy
  • Casa Amigos - Tequila vibes

Salty Senorita Area

  • Hi-Fi Kitchen - Live music
  • Kazimierz - Wine bar
  • The District - Multi-level

Arts District

  • Riot House - Rock and roll
  • Wasted Grain - Country crossover
  • Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row - Nashville style

Vehicle Options

Sprinter Van (8-12 passengers)

$175-275/hour

  • Most popular for nightlife
  • Easy in/out in formalwear
  • Sound system for pre-gaming
  • Comfortable seating

Party Bus (15-25 passengers)

$250-400/hour

  • Dance floor on board
  • Multiple bar areas
  • Statement arrival
  • Maximum party atmosphere

SUV (4-6 passengers)

$125-175/hour

  • Double date nights

  • More intimate setting

Sample Nightlife Itinerary

Standard Night Out (5 hours)

9:00 PM - Hotel/residence pickup
9:30 PM - Dinner at Culinary Dropout
11:00 PM - First club (Bottled Blonde)
12:30 AM - Second venue (Maya)
2:00 AM - Return transportation

Extended Celebration (7 hours)

7:00 PM - Pickup
7:30 PM - Dinner at Maple & Ash
9:30 PM - Pre-drinks at District Lounge
11:00 PM - Club circuit (3 venues)
2:00 AM - Late-night tacos

Pricing Comparison

Rideshare Reality (Saturday night)

  • 9 PM pickup: $25-40
  • 2 AM pickup: $60-120 (3-4x surge)
  • Wait time at 2 AM: 20-45 minutes
  • Split groups: Often can't fit 6+
  • Total for group of 8: $200-400

Our Service (8 passengers, 5 hours)

  • Fixed rate: $875-1,125
  • Per person: $110-140
  • No surge, no waiting
  • Group stays together
  • Pre-party on the way

Pro Tips

  1. Book Thursday for Fridays - Weekend fills fast
  2. Have a meeting spot - Where to find driver after each venue
  3. Dress code ready - Some clubs strict after 11 PM
  4. Cash tips help - Doormen remember faces
  5. Eat before drinking - Obvious but important
